about.title: About Paghman
about.intro: Paghman General Trading LLC specializes in international import and export, connecting suppliers and buyers across key global markets.
about.story: Paghman General Trading LLC is a Dubai-based trading company focused on international import and export, connecting trusted suppliers and markets across key regions. We are committed to reliable sourcing, efficient trade, and building long-term business relationships.
about.mission: To connect manufacturers and markets through reliable, transparent and efficient trading services that create value for every partner in the supply chain.
about.vision: To be the most trusted general trading house in the Middle East, recognised for quality, integrity and the strength of our global network.
